operations.summary: Binomial efficiency of tag-and-probe probes with the exact two-sided (central) Clopper-Pearson interval at interval_level from beta quantiles (core/stats/tail_estimation.py), no cap on the total. Counts mode: one bin from pass_count/total; total = 0 gives null efficiency and bounds with a reason. Probes mode: a CSV of probes, optional weights (frequency: integer counts, exactly the duplicated probes; sampling: Kish effective sample size) and bins of a variable. Only independent, non-background-subtracted probes with positive weights

inputs.name: pass_count
inputs.constraint: integer, 0 <= pass_count <= total; counts mode (with total), not with probes

inputs.name: total
inputs.constraint: integer >= 0, no upper cap; counts mode (with pass_count), not with probes

inputs.name: probes
inputs.constraint: CSV, one row per probe; probes mode (needs pass_column); not with pass_count/total

inputs.name: pass_column
inputs.constraint: column with 1 pass / 0 fail; probes mode

inputs.name: weights
inputs.constraint: column of positive weights; needs weight_kind; zero or negative weights are refused (hep-statistics)

inputs.name: weight_kind
inputs.constraint: frequency (integer counts) or sampling (Kish n_eff); no default, required with weights

inputs.name: level
inputs.constraint: confidence level of the central interval, finite, strictly in (0, 1)

inputs.name: status
inputs.constraint: one of the core artifact_statuses; echoed as status

failure_states.meaning: an argument is missing, not an integer, or out of range (pass_count > total, level outside (0, 1)), counts and probes both given, a probes file that cannot be read or has a missing column, a non-0/1 pass value, a zero or negative weight, a fractional frequency weight, weights without weight_kind, or bad bins; stdout carries {"ok": false, "error_kind": "invalid-input", "error": ...} and stderr one line
